product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides an operating system and cloud fleet-management software for commercial operators of autonomous drones and robots, bringing fleet telemetry, health, maintenance, and operations into a connected platform.
product_one_liner.notes: Synthesized from Auterion’s company description and its Auterion Suite product page.

pricing_page.notes: The public Suite page lists Basic, Pro, and Enterprise plans and prices for Basic and Pro.

named_customers.notes: Auterion’s release explicitly describes these as members of its global customer base.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Auterion lists its US headquarters in Arlington, Virginia, and its funding announcement describes the company as headquartered in Arlington, VA.

founded_year.notes: Auterion’s LinkedIn company profile lists 2017 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The technical blog includes multiple engineering-authored posts explaining collision-prevention/autonomy-stack work and visual-inertial navigation in GPS-denied settings.

public_docs.notes: Auterion has a public documentation site and a multi-page documentation index covering hardware, integrations, setup, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job inventory lists Computer Vision Engineer and Senior Computer Vision Engineer roles, which meet the requested AI/ML title criterion.

model_provider.value: Spleenlab’s VISIONAIRY® AI perception/ML software, which Auterion says can be deployed on Skynode and AI Node.
model_provider.notes: This is a named ecosystem AI-software provider, not a claim that all Auterion products use one universal foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The subprocessor statement names GDPR-compliant safeguards; it does not establish a separate third-party certification, and the examined statement does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile classifies the November 2025 Rheinmetall transaction as the latest corporate-minority investment, and Reuters confirms the direct stake; its amount was not disclosed. The required numeric amount is therefore 0 as a neutral placeholder, not a reported investment amount. The earlier disclosed Series B was $130 million in September 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: Rheinmetall’s direct investment in November 2025 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026; Auterion also announced a $130 million Series B in September 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The complete 25-job board lists no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title; the Sales & Marketing role shown is Mission Coordinator.

launched_6mo.notes: Auterion announced the Nemyx Vertical Launch System on October 5, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The published leadership roster is small. Scott Henry’s profile dates his CFO role’s end to September 2025 (before the 12-month window); his later Auterion Executive Advisor role ended in January 2026, but was not a C-level or VP title. No qualifying C-level/VP arrival or departure in the window was identified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A RevOps posting identifies HubSpot as the GTM stack/CRM; it mentions NetSuite as the integrated ERP, which is not listed here as a CRM or marketing system.
